_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: HedgeDoc
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: HedgeDoc is a collaborative Markdown editor: write notes, slides and diagrams together in the browser. The egg keeps notes in SQLite, with sign-in by email and password and sign-ups closed.
startup: h=$( (node --version; cat hedgedoc/yarn.lock) | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat hedgedoc/node_modules/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing HedgeDoc's dependencies"; (cd hedgedoc && YARN_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=0 YARN_ENABLE_PROGRESS_BARS=0 node .yarn/releases/yarn-*.cjs workspaces focus --production && rm -rf .yarn/cache) && echo "$h" > hedgedoc/node_modules/.raptor-installed || exit 1; fi; export NODE_ENV=production CMD_CONFIG_FILE=/home/container/config.json CMD_HOST=0.0.0.0 CMD_PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} CMD_DB_URL=sqlite:///home/container/data/hedgedoc.sqlite CMD_UPLOADS_PATH=/home/container/uploads CMD_SESSION_SECRET="$(cat .session-secret)" CMD_EMAIL=true CMD_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS_EDITS="${CMD_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS}"; [ -n "${CMD_DOMAIN:-}" ] || unset CMD_DOMAIN; cd hedgedoc || exit 1; if [ -n "${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then node -e 'require("./lib/models").runMigrations().then(() => process.exit(0), (e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1) })' || exit 1; out=$(node bin/manage_users --add "${ADMIN_EMAIL}" --pass "${ADMIN_PASSWORD}" 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc = 0 ]; then echo "Created the account ${ADMIN_EMAIL}."; elif [ $rc != 2 ]; then echo "$out"; exit 1; fi; fi; exec node app.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# HedgeDoc: downloads the release for the chosen version from GitHub
# (checked against GitHub's checksum) into hedgedoc/, replaced only once the
# new one is complete. Its dependencies are installed when the server
# starts, for the Node.js version it runs. Notes and accounts (data/),
# uploads, config.json and the session secret are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
rm -rf .raptor-new
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
want="${want#v}"
tag=$(gh-release tag hedgedoc/hedgedoc "$want") || fail "HedgeDoc has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 1.12.0, then reinstall."
version="$tag"

if [ -f hedgedoc/package.json ] && [ "$(jq -r .version hedgedoc/package.json)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "HedgeDoc $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading HedgeDoc $version"
    gh-release download hedgedoc/hedgedoc "$tag" "hedgedoc-$version.tar.gz" "$work/hedgedoc.tar.gz"
    mkdir .raptor-new
    tar -xzf "$work/hedgedoc.tar.gz" -C .raptor-new --strip-components=1
    [ -f .raptor-new/app.js ] && [ -d .raptor-new/public/build ] || { rm -rf .raptor-new; fail "HedgeDoc's release didn't have the app where it should. Report this to Raptor."; }
    rm -rf hedgedoc
    mv .raptor-new hedgedoc
fi
mkdir -p data uploads
# Your own settings go here (HedgeDoc's config.json format); the egg's
# variables take precedence.
[ -f config.json ] || echo '{"production": {}}' > config.json
# The secret that signs sign-in cookies: random, made once.
if [ ! -s .session-secret ]; then
    (umask 077; head -c 48 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d '\n' > .session-secret)
fi
echo "Installed HedgeDoc $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The HedgeDoc version to install, such as 1.12.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Admin email
variables.description: The email address of the account created at the start, when Admin password is set.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The account's password, set when the account is created. Leave it empty to make no account.

variables.name: Sign-ups
variables.description: Set it to true to let anyone create an account with their email address.

variables.name: Anonymous notes
variables.description: Set it to true to let people who aren't signed in create and edit notes.

variables.name: Domain
variables.description: The address people use, such as notes.example.com, for links HedgeDoc makes. Leave it empty to use relative links.

variables.name: HTTPS
variables.description: Set it to true when people reach HedgeDoc over HTTPS (through a proxy), so its links use https.
